description: This file contains functions for sorting payloads based on recency and priority, used in device database load operations.

methods.name: SortPayloadsByRecentAndContentPriority
methods.description: Sorts payloads by most recent update and content type priority.

methods.name: SortPayloadsByRecentAndUuidPriority
methods.description: Sorts payloads by most recent update and UUID priority.

methods.name: GetSortedPayloadsByPriority
methods.description: Main function that sorts payloads into categories and applies sorting based on content type and UUID priorities.
